FT-016-AC-011 / REQ-020 RED: no server-only browser transport exists; GREEN: fixed-loopback loads/actions forward only the allowed cookie/headers and expose no configured token, raw cookie, auth header, backend origin, provider credential, or raw error in page data, logs, errors, or capture inputs; decisive comparison: transport source inspection plus browser/server transcript and corpus scan; artifact: transport-privacy evidence under .tasks/TASK-081-T3-FT-016-W2/.
purpose: Establish the one security-sensitive PWA transport and navigation boundary reused by every provider-specific surface.
success_outcome: The SvelteKit server loads and actions call only the fixed loopback backend, keep cookies/tokens/backend origin out of page data, and render role/Plant navigation that never substitutes for backend authorization.
anti_goals: Do not add a browser-selected target origin, generic external proxy, CORS/LAN mode, token JSON, or client-side authorization authority.
Do not implement provider-specific Plant/Admin product surfaces beyond the reusable shell.

forbidden_scope: backend session, ActorContext, Plant permission, or lifecycle authority
browser-visible secrets, raw cookies, auth headers, or backend origin
generic proxy, CORS, LAN, or hosted deployment
stop_conditions: The shell cannot preserve backend authorization without duplicating it in the frontend.
The transport requires exposing tokens/origin or accepting an arbitrary proxy target.
A shared/global session or deployment decision is missing.

constraints: Use SvelteKit server load for initial data and server actions for forms; private transport code stays server-only.
Protected responses remain no-store and errors remain stable safe backend results.
invariants: Frontend visibility never grants Farm/Plant authority.
Logout, Account/auth change, and invalid session discard all transient selected-Plant and prompt state.
Backend ActorContext and Plant permission results remain authoritative.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-004: authorized, unauthorized, revoked, disabled, and archived browser results agree with backend outcomes.
FT-016-AC-011 / REQ-020: fixed-loopback server-only forwarding, no-store handling, and configured auth/secret corpus absence from browser-visible transport state.
T3 transport harm proof uses isolated Accounts/browser contexts and confirms safe rerun leaves no secret or unauthorized state residue.
